sources.title: WildCrane runner/README.md
sources.locator: Platform, startup, recovery, folders and shared settings
sources.finding: Current Runner documentation supports terminal operation on macOS, Windows and Linux and explicitly pauses desktop app support. Node 22 is required.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/README.md
sources.finding: The former ai4kanban npm package is replaced by wildcrane; both expose akb. Task commands use Cloud IDs and authenticated API calls.

sources.title: WildCrane docs/api/task-review.md
sources.finding: Documented Cloud review graphs freeze previews and invalidate affected downstream approvals when content or dependencies change. Closed server enforcement is not inspected.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/harnesses/index.ts
sources.finding: Current coded adapters include Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Kimi, dsh, ZCode, Grok and Antigravity.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/providers.ts
sources.finding: Per-harness provider declarations choose required settings and the runtime environment.

sources.title: WildCrane runner/src/main.ts
sources.locator: main sign-in, machine lock and lifecycle
sources.finding: Runner requires a local Cloud session, signs in when absent, registers detected runtimes and owns the execution connection.

sources.title: WildCrane runner/src/folders.ts
sources.finding: Account-scoped local folder grants resolve real paths, reject system/home roots, and persist atomically. These select starting directories rather than an OS sandbox.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/commands/task.ts
sources.finding: Task CRUD, comments, decisions, resume and stop operate on shared Cloud task identifiers.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/frontmatter.ts
sources.finding: Markdown card metadata retains priority, status, blocked_by, related, modules, source references, preview approvals, questions and archive/restoration fields.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/start.ts
sources.finding: Runs persist before a detached watcher starts. Sub-runs require a live parent, inherit its agent/runtime/folder and cannot create nested sub-runs.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/launch.ts
sources.finding: Watchers run in detached process groups with logs and survive the initiating terminal closing.

sources.title: WildCrane runner/src/connect.ts
sources.locator: readJobs, startWorker and recovered job handling
sources.finding: Runner reconciles claimed/interrupted jobs, preserves live flow workers and only starts jobs returned by the Cloud plan-limit admission service.

sources.title: WildCrane runner/src/jobs.ts
sources.locator: run job, checkpoint/recovery and result cost accumulation
sources.finding: Checkpoints track model attempts, synchronization failures, run evidence and usage. Recovery distinguishes known outcomes from unsafe repetition.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/retry.ts
sources.finding: The pinned code defines MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS=4 with persisted attempts and bounded exponential backoff; this is newer than the README three-attempt description.

sources.title: WildCrane runner/src/handoff.ts
sources.finding: Recovery hashes task outputs and Git state and can create a separate copy directory under .akb/handoffs without replacing existing work.

sources.title: WildCrane runner/src/task-folder.ts
sources.finding: Current job startup requires an authorized linked project folder. Local board caches synchronize by sequence with conflict preservation and pinned artifact versions.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/memory.ts
sources.locator: Project, module and agent memory paths
sources.finding: Markdown memory separates project guidance, planner decisions/rejections/redesigns and studio/agent memory.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/roles.ts
sources.finding: Built-in roles include discussion, memory pruning, conversation review and dismissal learning; role ownership is separate from CLI harness identity.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/complete.ts
sources.finding: Completion validates the owning run and unchanged requirements, records commit/branch receipts and archives once. It accepts a reported Git outcome; it is not itself a merge or test runner.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/manual.ts
sources.finding: The builder is instructed to manage its branch, worktree, checks and merge; a successful agent exit alone does not complete delivery.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/shared/delivery-evidence.ts
sources.finding: Approved requirements retain title, opening request, scope and specialist sections while excluding mutable task bookkeeping.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/approve.ts
sources.finding: Local approval rejects open questions and a running card owner before opening implementation.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/deliveries.ts
sources.finding: Local delivery JSON retains sessions, requirements, outcome and repairable incomplete archives. These local records do not establish immutable organizational audit history.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/own-cost.ts
sources.finding: Claude cumulative session cost is reduced by the prior saved total to avoid charging earlier turns again; missing baselines stay unknown.

sources.title: WildCrane runner/src/secrets.ts
sources.finding: Runtime keys stay in mode-0600 secrets.json; registration reports key names present rather than key values.

sources.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/machine/telemetry.ts
sources.finding: Usage reporting defaults on when unset. Opt-out clears queued events, sender state and install ID; unreadable settings disable reporting.

sources.title: WildCrane artifact-sdk/README.md
sources.finding: Artifact previews use version-pinned components and a sandboxed iframe bridge. Documentation specifies no-network rendering; hosted enforcement is closed.

sources.title: WildCrane LICENSE
sources.finding: The published source distribution is Apache-2.0; no Cloud source license is established.
